text:
Aisha (People Ops): quick flag 1 Lena1 converted from contractor -> W-2 effective 2026-05-01 but payroll exported city tax code as 'contractor' and withheld no Philly wage tax. employee says her city tax appears missing.
Lena Park (Employee): yep noticed net pay higher and then got a notice from Philly revenue that city wage tax wasn't remitted for April and they expect employer withholding. i'm worried about the liability.
Mark (Payroll): pulling records. conversion processed in HR on 2026-05-01 but payrun 2026-05-15 included pro-rated W-2 earnings for May and contractor pay for April (separate vendor payment). export mis-tagged April as contractor (legacy vendor id).
Pri (Manager): we thought vendor stop + hire start would cleanly split but sounds like crosswalk failed. Lena, sorry about the noise.
Diego (Tax): Philly wage tax (EIT) requires withholding when earnings are W-2 or when employer has payroll nexus. For April (contractor) employer wouldn't withhold; but Philly expects employer to withhold for wages. If April was actually earned as W-2 work (i.e., duties under employment), we need to reclassify. We need facts: was Lena providing work under contractor agreement in April or was she effectively an employee?
Lena Park (Employee): I was doing the same job before and after conversion; there was an overlap week where I signed the offer but continued on contractor PO until vendor invoice cleared. I thought HR scheduled the switch cleanly.
Aisha (People Ops): action plan: 1) payroll to confirm whether April should have been W-2; 2) if yes, run off-cycle to withhold city tax and adjust employer filings; 3) if not, provide employee proof and coordinate with Philly revenue to prevent duplicate billing.
Mark (Payroll): immediate step: reconcile vendor payments vs wages. vendor payment ID V-5589 shows invoice dated 2026-04-20 for work done April. payroll record shows paycode 'contg' for same period. i'll attach notes.
onboard-bot: HR record link: https://hr.example.company/onboard/lena_park_2026 (offer signed 2026-04-28, contractor end 2026-04-30).
Diego (Tax): if the contractor invoice covered the same hours as the W-2 period, we might need to gross-up or credit. Philly can assess employer withholding; they may allow an employer correction. Recommend voluntary withholding and remit to avoid employee getting assessed.
Mark (Payroll): estimate for correction: if we treat April as W-2, projected Philly tax withheld ~$28.40, employer portion adjustments minimal. We can either re-run a supplemental payroll to withhold and remit, or remit directly from company and adjust Lena's year-to-date with bookkeeping entry. Which do we prefer?
Aisha (People Ops): Lena, do you prefer we withhold from you retroactively or company pay the city and then deduct from future pay? We'll keep it reasonable.
Lena Park (Employee): i prefer company remit without reducing my net pay if possible. i don't want surprise deductions.
Pri (Manager): agree with company covering administrative burden this once. we'll log it as conversion transition error. please keep it documented for audit.
Diego (Tax): ok tax recommendation: company remit city tax for April and file an employer amendment for quarterly returns. record as 'employer correction - conversion misclassification' and document vendor/offer timeline. Employee will not be docked.
Mark (Payroll): I'll prepare an off-cycle journal: Company payment to City $28.40, record debit to payroll expense, credit cash. No employee deduction. Off-cycle memo: "Philly EIT remit for April 2026 due to contractor->W2 overlap for Lena Park - HR conversion timing."
Aisha (People Ops): please add case in HR tracker and attach vendor invoice + signed offer. Also update the conversion checklist to force a blocking step where vendor stop is confirmed before contractor hours processed.
Mark (Payroll): done. off-cycle payment recorded 2026-05-20 16:12 UTC. pay record updated; Lena's payslip annotated: "Employer-paid city tax adjustment for April 2026."
Lena Park (Employee): saw note and confirmation email. thanks for handling and for not docking me.
Aisha (People Ops): closing loop. will add process change to onboarding playbook and notify hiring ops. :white_check_mark:
